title: Capture tool imports test module for scenario constants (tools -> tests dependency inversion)
detail: A verify-surface tool documented in README depends on test code. Refactoring or restructuring tests/ breaks capture regeneration; data semantically belongs outside tests.
recommended_fix: Hoist REPLAY_CMDS/REPLAY_TICKS into a small non-test module (e.g. scripts/sim/replay_scenario.gd); both the test and the tool load it.

title: Replay scenario only half-shared: command-application tick differs between test and capture tool
evidence:
tools/determinism_log.gd:30  if t == ticks / 3:
tests/test_sim_replay.gd:22  if t == 120:
tests/test_sim_base.gd:11  ## capture and its sibling test can never drift apart.
detail: With REPLAY_TICKS=900 the tool applies commands at tick 300, the test at 120 — different worlds (capture shows 10 delivered, test pins >=12). The unshared timing knob can still drift despite the comment's promise.
recommended_fix: Define REPLAY_CMD_TICK once beside REPLAY_CMDS and use it in both the replay test and determinism_log.gd.

title: Acceptance suite's staging hook is the conventionally-private sim._spawn_packet plus deep queue-layout reads
evidence:
stranded += (sim.queues[pid][endpoint][lane] as Array).size()
(sim._spawn_packet used at 32 call sites across test_sim_flow/qos/sla and test_view_interaction)
detail: Contract tests bind to internal representation (_spawn_packet, queues[pid][endpoint][lane], inflight_a), so representation-preserving refactors break the suite. A public staging/observer seam would formalize it.
recommended_fix: Add public SimCore.spawn_packet() and small observers (e.g. queued_count(pipe, endpoint, lane)); migrate test call sites to them.

title: Occlusion pin forges FlowView's private pipe registry with sim-less synthetic arcs
detail: Testing pick_pipe by monkey-patching a private dict with pipe ids that have no sim backing couples the test to FlowView internals instead of its API.
recommended_fix: Give pick_pipe an optional candidates argument (defaulting to its registry) so the occlusion test passes synthetic arcs without touching _pipe_views.

title: Real-input-path _press/_move/_release helpers duplicated verbatim across two test files
evidence:
tests/test_view_interaction.gd:227 func _press(pos: Vector2) -> void:
	var e := InputEventMouseButton.new()
	... await tree.process_frame
(tests/test_gesture.gd:93-120 contains the byte-identical _press/_move/_release)
detail: Both files' click-vs-drag validity rests on the same 30-line driver (including the two-frame settle); a needed change must be applied twice and can silently diverge.
recommended_fix: Move _press/_move/_release into tests/test_base.gd (both files already extend it) and delete the copies.
